title: IX_Orders_InvoiceDate: 0 reads, 6.4M writes
prompt: Azure SQL Database 'RetailOps', General Purpose, 8 vCores, about 41.5 GB of memory, compatibility level 160, no readable secondary. Snapshot taken Thursday 2026-09-24 09:00 UTC. A platform failover reset the index usage counters on 2026-09-15 02:41, so they cover 9.26 days. Query Store holds data from 2026-09-11 only, because size-based cleanup has run. Month-end change freeze: 2026-09-30 18:00 to 2026-10-02 18:00. Flash sale on 2026-10-09 with a change freeze from 2026-10-08. Log rate cap: 36 MB/s. Space headroom: 213 GB.
The advisor script recommends: DROP INDEX IX_Orders_InvoiceDate, '0 reads, 6.4M writes'. Decide.
facts: dbo.Orders: 182M rows, 350k inserts a day, about 2.1M status updates a day, 340k invoice updates a day.
Job 'finance-month-end' runs at 06:00 on business days 1 and 2 of each month; finance can rerun it until business day 5. The VAT extract must finish by 08:00 on business day 1.
Job history: 2026-09-01 finance.usp_MonthEndVatReturn 6m52s; 2026-09-02 6m31s; 2026-09-03 ad hoc rerun 6m40s. Next run: 2026-10-01 06:00.

finance.usp_MonthEndVatReturn filters dbo.Orders on InvoiceDate >= @PeriodStart AND InvoiceDate < @PeriodEnd (about 10.5M rows a month) and reads InvoiceNo, CountryCode, CurrencyCode, ChannelId, TotalAmount and TaxAmount.
No plan for the month-end procedures exists in Query Store or in the plan cache: both evidence windows start after the last run.
Query Store is configured with STALE_QUERY_THRESHOLD_DAYS = 30, but its storage is full (2,046 of 2,048 MB) and the oldest interval is 2026-09-11.
The clustered index is 42.1 GB and the buffer pool about 41.5 GB.

decisions.why: It serves the month-end VAT return, which runs outside both evidence windows and next runs within a week.

harmful_removals.why: The VAT return would scan a 42 GB clustered index, larger than the buffer pool, on business day 1, miss its 08:00 deadline and push the OLTP working set out of memory.

key.reference_notes: Usage counters do not survive a failover, and Query Store keeps less than its configured 30 days. Save daily usage snapshots, raise the Query Store size, and review again after the October month-end.
